markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2028 presidential race remains wide open more than two years out, with no dominant candidate and probabilities spread across more than a dozen figures from both parties. The lack of an incumbent, combined with term limits and post-2024 party dynamics, has kept early positioning fluid. Republican contenders such as JD Vance and Marco Rubio hold the highest implied probabilities, while Democratic options including Gavin Newsom and Jon Ossoff trail, reflecting ongoing intra-party competition and voter realignment. Midterm results, primary debates, endorsements, and state-level polling will likely create separation as candidates consolidate support ahead of formal nominations. Trader consensus continues to price in substantial uncertainty around these variables.
